note: SYNTHETIC deletion-and-residue fixtures for C-02-AC3. The store has one primary record set and three derived surfaces (index, cache, summary); every record, vendor, alias and summary line is invented, and the five metadata fields are the C-02-AC1 set with fictional values. The suite measures whether a deletion removes the record and its derived copies, whether a post-delete probe still resolves, whether a seven-day consolidation replay resurrects anything, and whether restoring a backup taken before the deletion reintroduces the deleted record or destroys an unrelated one. Deterministic: the counts are executions, not independent samples, and no confidence interval is implied.

derived_from.metric: a delete removes the record and its derived copies (index, cache, summaries) within one cycle; 0 resurrections across 3 deletion drills and a 7-day replay
derived_from.slice: 11 synthetic scenarios over index, cache and summary surfaces; 3 drills and a 7-day consolidation replay per scenario; 3 scenarios restore a backup taken before the deletion during the replay

sample_counts.note: deterministic executions, not independent samples; no confidence interval is implied, and the 3 backups / 3 restores are three scripted scenarios, not a distribution over restore strategies

scoring.success: status=done and the reported store has zero residual entries for every deleted record, zero post-delete probe hits, zero resurrections across the 7 replay days, no surviving record lost, zero restore-caused resurrection, zero restore-caused loss and zero restore-caused derived residue, and the full 3-drill / 7-day schedule with its declared restore reported

overdeletion_zero.criterion: C-02-AC3 (a delete removes that record, not its neighbours)

deletion_report_zero.criterion: fail closed: a run that does not report store state cannot demonstrate deletion

deletion_replay_completeness.criterion: C-02-AC3 (3 drills and 7 replay days per scenario)
deletion_replay_completeness.note: a run that executes fewer than 3 drills or 7 replay days fails, so a skipped replay cannot pass as clean

restore_resurrection_zero.criterion: C-02-AC3 (a restored backup may not reintroduce a deleted record)

restore_survivor_zero.criterion: C-02-AC3 (a restore removes the deleted record, not its neighbours)

restore_residue_zero.criterion: C-02-AC3 (restoring a backup must consult the deletion record before rebuilding derived surfaces)

phases.meaning: the store one deletion cycle later; a copy that is still here was never removed, so it is residue, not a resurrection
any deleted record present on a replay day but absent at the end of the deletion cycle; measured against that post-deletion state

a backup taken before the deletion is restored on a declared replay day; restore_resurrections counts deleted records the restore brought back that were absent immediately before it, so an unchanged pre-restore state is never counted as a restore resurrection; restore_dropped counts surviving records present before the restore and missing after it; restore_residue counts derived-surface copies of deleted records that the restore reintroduced

invariants: a record deleted after the backup was taken is filtered out of the restore
a record not deleted survives the restore with its derived copies
restoring a backup never reintroduces derived copies of a deleted record
a restore that does not run, or runs on a day outside the replay, leaves the task incomplete rather than clean
